startupStrings.execution: decoded once before startup; function bodies excluded

cityGeneration.execution: cached numeric batches; no per-cell WASM calls

blockGeneration.execution: cached district/block tables and complete parcel geometry

interiorGeneration.execution: bounded room command plans and shell buffers

renderCaches.farWallColorRounding: exact toFixed fallback near decimal ties
renderCaches.trackInvalidation: terrain revision and streamed world origin

startupRendering.resolve: GPU batch plus one Canvas2D scene copy before the original dissolve

identityGeneration.execution: cached UTF-8 atlas and naming records

pilotGeneration.execution: one bounded startup packet; fixed layouts compiled into native builder calls and immutable data

authoredGeneration.execution: one bounded startup packet of native authored construction records
